title: Edit Form Settings » Developer Settings
text:
## Edit Form Settings » Developer Settings
Link: https://support.brilliantdirectories.com/support/solutions/articles/12000078825
In this article, we will go over the Developer Settings found under Edit Form Settings.
[IMAGE: https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/12090917736/original/lcUjeqwT-3nS3E0BanaWSz32pTM9WixRSA.png?1617670304 | alt: ]

## Form System Name
Here, the form’s system name can be specified. Use only alphanumeric characters and underscores, with no spaces.

## Input Field Settings

## Field Label Position
This setting allows you to control where labels appear within the form.
[IMAGE: https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/12090917819/original/oUu-sp06ME-ilzPKaU0hqxp7uWFz3OPLog.png?1617670493 | alt: ]
The front-end view when Labels Above Inputs is selected:
[IMAGE: https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/12090917853/original/lsbnXSc2LkP6gz_A7X1YxUmOZ-6ahmRLRw.png?1617670550 | alt: ]
The front-end view when Labels Left of Inputs is selected:
[IMAGE: https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/12090917894/original/YrU07kjwxi1kO35nmYdmn5UyHr8rWARpRg.png?1617670615 | alt: ]

## Use Field Label as Placeholder Text?
When enabled, field labels will display as placeholder text inside the input fields.
[IMAGE: https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/12090917994/original/v2Sq65HsezSUFRlKGPatbK0P_OlVYRMrZA.png?1617670800 | alt: ]

## <input> Field CSS Classes
CSS classes entered here will be applied to all input fields in the form.
Bootstrap CSS Forms Reference

## Form Settings
Additional form settings are available further down under Developer Settings.
[IMAGE: https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/12090918200/original/tXh6KO4GBmgllYc2h1z1JBeNc8biEZR-uQ.png?1617671162 | alt: ]

## <form> Assign Unique ID
A unique ID can be assigned to the selected form. This ID is applied directly to the <form> element.
[IMAGE: https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/12090918282/original/KwPWt6Xv4qey8_m22wT0XFTUNv0IKDZp0g.png?1617671286 | alt: ]

## <form> CSS Classes
Multiple CSS classes can be applied directly to the <form> element.
[IMAGE: https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/12090918361/original/WdnQqCgjnwEaemGM9NFJRCPIc8s_SgVZ5g.png?1617671468 | alt: ]
[IMAGE: https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/12090918373/original/9YVCaGmh43gW5uuTvJX4BL0KMiOj0fmT_w.png?1617671523 | alt: ]

## <form> Inline Styles
Inline styles entered here will apply directly to the <form> element.
[IMAGE: https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/12090918406/original/h51WGQpU-wZUejxYC1cMS5Rec4fDhD54Ww.png?1617671648 | alt: ]
[IMAGE: https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/12090918420/original/l1oD-jW8Xy0iVz3RVt0CIiwjZaqOKXnn5Q.png?1617671688 | alt: ]

## Save Action URL
This setting allows you to modify the default action= attribute of the form.

## ID to Replace After Form Submitted
This option defines a target ID that will be replaced after form submission. This only works when Display Success Pop-Up Message is enabled under Edit Form Settings → Submission Settings.

## Database Settings
Additional database-related options are available further down under Developer Settings.
[IMAGE: https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/12090918717/original/4vwkthV1xwqV-qGeuXfgq13HM7I1cZJ9Ow.png?1617672289 | alt: ]

## What Database Table Should Submissions Post To?
This setting determines which database table receives the submitted form data. Only modify this if you are familiar with database tables.

## Primary Key
A unique field identifier can be specified for the selected database table.
